channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Free throws | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Free throws from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Free throws, Aday Mara
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Aday Mara shooting 13-of-17 on free throws in preseason:

“That's something that we're working on with him… We're trying to help him build a skillset that can sustain over the course of a long career.”

Mark Daigneault on Free throws, Aday Mara, Oct 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Free throws, Amen Thompson
item.description:
Rafael Stone on Amen Thompson:

“I think he's a very, very good basketball player. Since about halfway through his rookie year, we've been a materially better team when he's on the court. And he keeps getting better. I thought he had a really good year last year. He just got better and better and better and better. And he helps our team on the court in literally every way you can. We turn the ball over less, we turn the other team over more, we rebound better, we shoot a higher percentage, we shoot free throws better. Everything's better with Amen Thompson. So yeah, we're very, very high on him.”

Rafael Stone on Free throws, Amen Thompson, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Free throws, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Legion Hoops:Magic Johnson on De'Aaron Fox:

“He should’ve pulled the ball back out… I think that play really hurt the Spurs. Wemby’s two free throws he missed hurt the spurs. De’Aaron is a point guard, you gotta know every situation. My job as a point guard was to know every situation.”

Magic Johnson on Free throws, De'Aaron Fox, Jun 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Free throws
item.description:
“The whistle that OKC gets. You know, I saw Shai had [17 or 18] free throws one game,”

Draymond Green on Free throws, Apr 28, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Free throws, Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Darko Rajakovic:

“Their whole team is very very physical with Brandon. So for me it's very interesting that he had 0 free throws in this game. Seeing zero takes, zero makes, it's interesting”

Darko Rajakovic on Free throws, Brandon Ingram, Apr 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brian Keefe on Free throws
item.description:
Wizards head coach Brian Keefe told reporters.

“Sixteen free throws in the fourth quarter. Just tried to take the ball out of his hands. He still got some free throws 40 feet from the rim. I can’t explain some of those calls. That’s all I got to say on that.”

Brian Keefe on Free throws, Mar 11, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Free throws
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Bam's 83-point night.

“First thing you think is how — not because of him but because of the way he plays. I saw he only made six threes but 40 free throws or something like that, tells the story right there,”

Ime Udoka on Free throws, Mar 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Free throws
item.description:
coach Jordi Fernandez said, tongue in cheek.

“It was physical on both ends … and I’m happy with that. I think we drove enough times that we should’ve gotten the same amount of free throws. But, it is what it is.”

Jordi Fernandez on Free throws, Dec 19, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Tom Crean, Free throws
item.description:
Chris Hine:Anthony Edwards:

“After he did what he did this summer, a bunch of dudes was texting me like, bro you gotta change this 'cause they gonna start doing it. Coach (Tom) Crean texted me about it. I was like, I just gotta change my free throws.”

Anthony Edwards on Tom Crean, Free throws, Nov 29, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mike Brown on Free throws
item.description:
But until that happens — or maybe even after that happens — the coach said Robinson isn’t expected to play much down the stretch of close contests.

“Obviously, he’s got to make free throws. We have a rotation and most times in the rotation at the end of games Josh [Hart] is going to be out there [at power forward],”

Mike Brown on Free throws, Nov 21, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mike Brown on Free throws, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
“So [Robinson] won’t be out there a ton, but if we need a rebound, he’s going to be out there.“And he’s got to knock down the free throws. And he’s working at it, we’re working at it with him, and I truly believe he’s going to get better.”

Mike Brown on Free throws, Mitchell Robinson, Nov 21, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Free throws
item.description:
Reaves told The Athletic.

“Like that, you’re gonna shoot free throws. You’ll shoot 10 free throws a game if you’re aggressive to the basket. “We know you can shoot big range jumpers, but once you put that pressure on the rim, that’s gonna change the dynamic of the game.”

Austin Reaves on Free throws, Oct 25, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Free throws, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“Watch Anthony Edwards when he takes a free throw shot. Watch when he shoots his free throws. Every single time he steps over the line - every time. And if you remember back in the day, I used to send in tapes on Shaq... We sent in the Shaq and they started calling it, and he had to fix his free throws. Anthony Edwards, we had a game against them, where they were up like 93-92, with a few seconds left. He goes two feet; you know, he steps over the line and then the ball crosses... goes into the basket. I'm like, this is the easiest call for a referee. Just watch to see if he steps over the line, and they refused to call it.. Tell the league, (but they) refuse to call it.”

Mark Cuban on Free throws, Anthony Edwards, Sep 12, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Josh Hart on Free throws
item.description:
Knicks guard Josh Hart said before Game 6 in Detroit.

“I don’t know what the numbers are, but from my perception, he’s been shooting free throws very well. If they’re going to do that, let them do that. We’ll get stops. He’s so important to us defensively. Even if he makes one out of two, if we get five stops in a row and they foul him five times in a row and he makes five free throws, then we’re a plus-5. We got faith in him on both sides of the court.”

Josh Hart on Free throws, May 7, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Fred VanVleet on Stephen Curry, Free throws
item.description:
“We’re going to continue to do that. I think we can generate better looks, I think our spacing can get better, I think we can make more shots, obviously. Myself included;(I) didn’t shoot the ball great tonight. We missed nine free throws. Steph (Curry) hit some crazy shots. I liked our fight and intensity, but it’s about execution.”

Fred VanVleet on Stephen Curry, Free throws, Apr 21, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Free throws, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Kyrie Irving:

“Kyrie's a massive loss. I feel awful about that. He's done a lot for Dallas. He has really changed the perception of him. He's always been one of the more likeable guys in the league. Just watching him was sad, watching him shoot free throws.”

Doc Rivers on Free throws, Kyrie Irving, Mar 5, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Free throws
item.description:
Towns said after the game.

“I expect to make them all. When you look back at the game, especially when you don’t come out with a win in a tough game like this, you look at everything that you could have done in the mirror. “If I make a few of those free throws, at least two or three of them, you put your team in a different position.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Free throws, Nov 14, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Free throws, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun potentially improving this season as a free throw shooter and defender:

“I've never really taken Alperen (out of a game) due to free throws. Defensively, that's a different thing, obviously. At times, you want to be able to switch and have favorable matchups on that end. [Improvement] will keep him on the floor, as it does a lot of guys, but we're very specific with who we sub at the end of games specifically for offense and defense. The better he is, the more he will be out there.”

Ime Udoka on Free throws, Alperen Sengun, Oct 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Free throws
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Doncic on the 12-of-23 FT shooting:

“We've just got to work on our free-throws. We only shot 52%. It's unacceptable.”

Luka Doncic on Free throws, May 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Free throws
item.description:
“Yeah, and just not being able to communicate with the officials is frustrating as well. When you have to ask them a question and they don’t even look at you, they don’t even acknowledge you, very frustrating. And I think they’re hacking Joker. I think he’s been getting fouled all year. I don’t think he shoots nearly enough free throws, of what he should shoot. So yeah, it was just frustrating. I don’t like seeing my big fella get hacked with no calls.”

Aaron Gordon on Free throws, May 7, 2024. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Free throws
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on adjusting to how games are called:

“If I were a journalist, I’d probably look at all the free throws and then I’d probably look at the screens. That’s probably what I'd do.”

Tom Thibodeau on Free throws, Apr 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic, Free throws
item.description:
Michael Malone on generating more free-throws:

“We still have to play aggressive, which I thought we did (in Game 1). We have to look to post up Nikola, which we did. We took a lot of shots in the paint. We scored 64 in the paint. I'm not really sure how we can generate more.”

Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic, Free throws, Apr 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Free throws
item.description:
“I thought it was the halftime stats. I didn't look at the minutes. And then I said, 'Wow, two free throws for a basketball game. That's crazy.'”

Doc Rivers on Free throws, Apr 10, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Willie Green on Free throws, Zion Williamson
item.description:
Willie on Zion Williamson's lack of calls:

“It's frustrating for all of us. You feel like Zion is elite at attacking the basket and he's not getting those calls. DeRozan tonight shoots 12 free throws. Zion shoots two. That's frustrating.”

Willie Green on Free throws, Zion Williamson, Feb 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Free throws
item.description:
Mark Daigneault:

“We’d like to get to the line more as a team with the way we drive the ball. We certainly would expect to go to the line looking at the very cold hard facts…All (the) metrics would point to us having more free throws. So we’d like to shoot more free throws. I think we could be shooting more free throws.”

Mark Daigneault on Free throws, Jan 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Free throws
item.description:
Kendra Andrews:Kerr:

“I might comment on the free throws but my mom is here so I want to be on my best behavior. So I’m not going to comment on their 43 free throws to our 16.I’m not going to comment on Steph shooting three free throws in 43 minutes.”

Steve Kerr on Free throws, Jan 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @kendra__andrews.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Free throws
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“I’m not going to comment on their 43 free throws to our 16.I’m not going to comment on Steph shooting three free throws in 43 minutes.”

Steve Kerr on Free throws, Jan 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Jaden McDaniels on Free throws, Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Jaden McDaniels on Mikal Bridges missing the free throws at the end:

“I knew he was going to miss. I just knew he was.”

Jaden McDaniels on Free throws, Mikal Bridges, Jan 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Free throws
item.description:
“We just want balance and consistency, that's it. I see Bron shooting four free throws. And the amount of times he attacked the rim, the amount of times he was slapped on the arm, which I could see plain as day, for that not to be called, man ... he's not flopping. I'm watching him go to the hole strong.”

Darvin Ham on Free throws, Nov 7, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Free throws
item.description:
SGA on his lack of free throws:

“I honestly have no clue. I guess that’s just the way the game goes. Sometimes you get calls, sometimes you don’t. I won’t change the way I play. I’ll try the same thing tomorrow.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Free throws, Oct 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
